<script id="wix-first-paint">
    if (window.ResizeObserver &&
        (!window.PerformanceObserver || !PerformanceObserver.supportedEntryTypes || PerformanceObserver.supportedEntryTypes.indexOf('paint') === -1)) {
        new ResizeObserver(function (entries, observer) {
            entries.some(function (entry) {
                var contentRect = entry.contentRect;
                if (contentRect.width > 0 && contentRect.height > 0) {
                    requestAnimationFrame(function (now) {
                        window.wixFirstPaint = now;
                        dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('wixFirstPaint'));
                    });
                    observer.disconnect();
                    return true;
                }
            });
        }).observe(document.body);
    }
</script>


<script id="scroll-bar-width-calculation">
    const div = document.createElement('div')
    div.style.overflowY = 'scroll'
    div.style.width = '50px'
    div.style.height = '50px'
    div.style.visibility = 'hidden'
    document.body.appendChild(div)
    const scrollbarWidth= div.offsetWidth - div.clientWidth
    document.body.removeChild(div)
    if(scrollbarWidth > 0){
        document.body.style.setProperty('--scrollbar-width', `${scrollbarWidth}px`)
    }
</script>

data-main-content="true"><div id="SITE_PAGES" class="Y3K28_ SITE_PAGES"><div id="SITE_PAGES_TRANSITION_GROUP" class="uvik8H"><div id="icda3" class="i0StQr theme-vars icda3"><div class="pTvOx2 wixui-page" data-testid="page-bg"></div><div class="JJb9Mt"><div id="Containericda3" class="Containericda3 wH18kY"><div data-mesh-id="Containericda3inlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="Containericda3inlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><section id="comp-lxxlv0ye2" tabindex="-1" class="Le88gL comp-lxxlv0ye2 wixui-section" data-block-level-container="ClassicSection"><div id="bgLayers_comp-lxxlv0ye2" data-hook="bgLayers" data-motion-part="BG_LAYER comp-lxxlv0ye2" class="QG9w8P"><div data-testid="colorUnderlay" class="LNYVZi ayCf9D"></div><div id="bgMedia_comp-lxxlv0ye2" data-motion-part="BG_MEDIA comp-lxxlv0ye2" class="ROWgFb"></div></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-lxxlv0ye2inlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-lxxlv0ye2inlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><section id="comp-ksukm5ey" class="comp-ksukm5ey CeUMmm wixui-column-strip"><div id="bgLayers_comp-ksukm5ey" data-hook="bgLayers" data-motion-part="BG_LAYER comp-ksukm5ey" class="ktMZav"><div data-testid="colorUnderlay" class="V9k0ll etGVsi"></div><div id="bgMedia_comp-ksukm5ey" data-motion-part="BG_MEDIA comp-ksukm5ey" class="etSQ9j"></div></div><div data-testid="columns" class="Ak0vpt"><div id="comp-ksukm5ez" class="comp-ksukm5ez FDI5TK wixui-column-strip__column"><div id="bgLayers_comp-ksukm5ez" data-hook="bgLayers" data-motion-part="BG_LAYER comp-ksukm5ez" class="QG9w8P"><div data-testid="colorUnderlay" class="LNYVZi ayCf9D"></div><div id="bgMedia_comp-ksukm5ez" data-motion-part="BG_MEDIA comp-ksukm5ez" class="ROWgFb"></div></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ksukm5ezinlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-ksukm5ezinlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-ld1pbxck" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq comp-ld1pbxck wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_2 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:30px; line-height:normal;"><span style="font-size:30px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:raleway-semibold,raleway,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="color:#2A2A2A;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Financiamento</span></span></span></span></h2></div><div id="comp-ld1pdk4p" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq comp-ld1pdk4p wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h1 class="font_0 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:15px;"><span style="font-size:15px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:raleway,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Passo a Passo</span></span></h1></div><div id="comp-ld1pbhvh" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq comp-ld1pbhvh wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:17px; line-height:1.4em;"><span class="color_15 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:17px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,avenir-lt-w05_35-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">De acordo com pesquisas recentes no território verde-amarelo, a cada 10 veículos, cerca de 7 foram adquiridos a partir de financiamentos. É a maneira mais prática e comum de adquirir um veículo em nosso país. </span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:17px; line-height:1.4em;">&nbsp;</p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:17px; line-height:1.4em;"><span class="color_15 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:17px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,avenir-lt-w05_35-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Mas quais são os passos e os requisitos que preciso ter para que eu possa fazer um financiamento? O que é necessário para que as chances de aprovação sejam maiores?</span></span></span></span></span></span></p></div><div id="comp-ld1orerd" class="q9dEZ5 comp-ld1orerd"><div class="vV1v8L wixui-box" data-testid="container-bg"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld1orerdinlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld1orerdinlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-ld1oresl" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq comp-ld1oresl wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_2 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px; line-height:normal; text-align:center;"><span style="font-size:20px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:raleway-semibold,raleway,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">1</span></span></span></span></h2></div></div></div></div><div id="comp-ld0ruvhz" class="evZSmJ comp-ld0ruvhz"><div class="y6PJGG wixui-box" data-testid="container-bg"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0ruvhzinlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0ruvhzinlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0rk7o7-rotated-wrapper"><div id="comp-ld0rk7o7" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq comp-ld0rk7o7 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_2 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px; line-height:normal; text-align:center;"><span style="font-size:20px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:raleway-semibold,raleway,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Nome Limpo</span></span></span></span></h2></div></div></div></div></div><div id="comp-ld0qzg6f" class="evZSmJ comp-ld0qzg6f"><div class="y6PJGG wixui-box" data-testid="container-bg"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0qzg6finlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0qzg6finlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-ld0qpmu3" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq comp-ld0qpmu3 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:17px; line-height:1.4em;"><span class="color_15 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:17px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,avenir-lt-w05_35-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Se a sua intenção é financiar um veículo, o primeiro passo é não estar negativado. Em outras palavras, garantir que seu nome não esteja na lista dos órgãos de proteção de crédito, como Serasa ou SPC.</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:17px; line-height:1.4em;"><br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<span class="color_15 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:17px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,avenir-lt-w05_35-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Ter alguma restrição no nome, pendência em aberto ou dívida em atraso leva o seu nome a ser negativado, prejudicando o seu nome e o seu “score”, indicando ao mercado que a pessoa é uma má pagadora. Por isso, é de extrema importância ficar com o nome limpo.</span></span></span></span></span></span></p></div></div></div></div><div id="comp-ld1ozl8z" class="q9dEZ5 comp-ld1ozl8z"><div class="vV1v8L wixui-box" data-testid="container-bg"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld1ozl8zinlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld1ozl8zinlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-ld1ozlax" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq comp-ld1ozlax wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_2 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px; line-height:normal; text-align:center;"><span style="font-size:20px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:raleway-semibold,raleway,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">2</span></span></span></span></h2></div></div></div></div><div id="comp-ld0rwe90" class="evZSmJ comp-ld0rwe90"><div class="y6PJGG wixui-box" data-testid="container-bg"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0rwe90inlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0rwe90inlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0rwe91-rotated-wrapper"><div id="comp-ld0rwe91" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq comp-ld0rwe91 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_2 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px; line-height:normal; text-align:center;"><span style="font-size:20px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:raleway-semibold,raleway,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Score</span></span></span></span></h2></div></div></div></div></div><div id="comp-ld0rwe8x" class="evZSmJ comp-ld0rwe8x"><div class="y6PJGG wixui-box" data-testid="container-bg"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0rwe8xinlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0rwe8xinlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-ld0rwe8y1" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq comp-ld0rwe8y1 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:17px; line-height:1.4em;"><span class="color_15 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:17px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,avenir-lt-w05_35-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Depois de ter deixado o nome limpo, outro passo importante para o financiamento é ter um bom score. Mas afinal, o que é isso?</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:17px; line-height:1.4em;"><br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<span class="color_15 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:17px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,avenir-lt-w05_35-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">O score é uma pontuação que indica ao mercado se você é um bom ou mau pagador, variando de 0 até 1000. Quanto mais próximo do mil, melhor é o perfil financeiro da pessoa, aumentando as chances de aprovação no financiamento.<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
Entretanto, quanto menor a pontuação, maiores são as chances de ter um pedido de crédito recusado.&nbsp;</span></span></span></span></span></span></p></div></div></div></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0r9nbs-rotated-wrapper"><div id="comp-ld0r9nbs" class="comp-ld0r9nbs nJiBti wixui-horizontal-line"></div></div><div id="comp-ld0ryb1i" class="q9dEZ5 comp-ld0ryb1i"><div class="vV1v8L wixui-box" data-testid="container-bg"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0ryb1iinlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0ryb1iinlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-ld0ryb2y" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq comp-ld0ryb2y wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_2 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px; line-height:normal; text-align:center;"><span style="font-size:20px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:raleway-semibold,raleway,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">3</span></span></span></span></h2></div></div></div></div><div id="comp-ld0ryb29" class="evZSmJ comp-ld0ryb29"><div class="y6PJGG wixui-box" data-testid="container-bg"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0ryb29inlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0ryb29inlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0ryb2a1-rotated-wrapper"><div id="comp-ld0ryb2a1" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq comp-ld0ryb2a1 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_2 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px; line-height:normal; text-align:center;"><span style="font-size:20px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:raleway-semibold,raleway,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Idade mínima e máxima</span></span></span></span></h2></div></div></div></div></div><div id="comp-ld0ryb2b3" class="evZSmJ comp-ld0ryb2b3"><div class="y6PJGG wixui-box" data-testid="container-bg"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0ryb2b3inlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0ryb2b3inlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-ld0ryb2d" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq comp-ld0ryb2d wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:17px; line-height:1.4em;"><span class="color_15 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:17px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,avenir-lt-w05_35-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Outro fator que é levado em conta durante o processo de financiamento é a idade da pessoa. A idade mínima é de 20 anos, já que, antes disso, dificilmente a pessoa irá possuir um crédito robusto, não s</span></span></span></span></span><span style="font-size:17px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,avenir-lt-w05_35-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">endo possível saber se é uma boa ou mau pagadora.</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:17px; line-height:1.4em;"><br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<span class="color_15 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:17px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,avenir-lt-w05_35-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Já a idade máxima é de 70 anos, isso, em razão da expectativa de vida no Brasil, cerca de 76 anos segundo o IBGE. Portanto, fazer a aprovação de um financiamento a longo prazo, seria um negócio arriscado.&nbsp;</span></span></span></span></span></span></p></div></div></div></div><div id="comp-ld0s370g" class="q9dEZ5 comp-ld0s370g"><div class="vV1v8L wixui-box" data-testid="container-bg"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0s370ginlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0s370ginlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-ld0s372m" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq comp-ld0s372m wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_2 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px; <script id="wix-skip-played-animations">
    window.__pageRevealPromise && window.__pageRevealPromise.then(function() {
        requestAnimationFrame(function() {
            try {
                var stored = sessionStorage.getItem('wix-motion-played-animations');
                if (stored) {
                    var played = JSON.parse(stored);
                    for (var compId in played) {
                        if (played[compId]) {
                            var el = document.getElementById(compId);
                            if (el) {
                                el.dataset.motionEnter = 'done';
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (e) {}
        });
    });
